style.styleTitle: Lights4fun 2ft Pre Lit Potted Grandis Fir Outdoor Plug in Christmas Tree
style.toneOfVoice: Seize the celebration with the 60cm Pre Lit Potted Grandis Fir Outdoor Plug in Christmas Tree. Standing at 60cm tall, it goes great in gardens and front lawns alongside potted plants; the artificial foliage can handle both sun and rain without worry, ever-glowing with the ‘on’ mode, or the optional 6-hour timer can turn the lights on automatically every evening and off again to save you the work. So, you focus on family and friends, the lights are low maintenance, their inspirational shine picking you up through the winter. Style it on your front lawn or garden to sparkle and excite friends, family, and passersby. The discreet cable and black pot blend into the evening to make the shine stand out. The pre lit potted tree is a marvellous addition to your outdoor space. Inspire friends and family and keep the night aglow. Have an uplifting winter with the mighty Grandis Fir. Make your garden a magic wonderland. If you treat it with care, you can bring it out year on year. Dimensions(mm): Height: 600 Width: 620 Depth: 620.
